correctness.rationale: For uniform functions with prescribed target multiplicities d_i, each set of r distinct prescribed fixed points has probability product(d_i)/(n)_r, hence PGF P_d(z)=sum e_r(d)(z-1)^r/(n)_r. A balancing move (a,b)->(a-1,b+1) increases e_{r+2} by (a-b-1)e_r(c). The remaining sum is the PGF of genuine n-2-place matching count with a nonmatching filler letter, so P_new-P_old = (a-b-1)(z-1)^2 P_Y(z)/[n(n-1)]. This yields exact stop-loss increment, strict convex order under a nontrivial integral-majorization chain, and variance/extremal laws including n=2. An independent complete labeled-map enumeration for n=4 gave distributions (1/4,1/2,1/4) vs (1/3,1/3,1/3) and difference (1/12,-1/6,1/12). This is a correctness PASS, not scientific originality.
